card.name: Words just before the noun resource
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'resource' or similar singular noun, such as 'irreplaceable', 'the', 'this', 'most' and 'plentiful' after phrases about water, oil or assets. It also fires on 'this' or 'the' before a singular noun that refers back to something just mentioned.

modes.label: Before 'resource'
modes.description: Adjectives or determiners that lead into 'resource' when naming a natural or valuable thing.
modes.example: the nation's law for protecting our most irreplace<<able>> resource Emergency Preparedness

modes.label: Referring back with this or the
modes.description: A 'this' or 'the' that points to a thing just discussed, such as a symptom or event.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words for 'this item' or 'this one of', and suppresses plural 'these' words, which favors a singular 'this' noun.
card.plain: It fires on the small words just before the noun 'resource', where a singular 'this one' noun is expected.
